messages:
Liam (Sales): Heads-up: closed WillowBank (mid-market) on 12mo Dedicated. Key asks: VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, SCIM sync for Okta, 99p latency <=500ms. Signed but procurement may delay KMS. Created intake ticket CS-8110. Can CS pick up onboarding and loop Eng/Support? :handshake:
Priya (CS): On it. Need billing contact, Okta metadata, and customer's CIDR. I'll prepare kickoff and capture risks.
Liam (Sales): Billing contact is "tara@willowbank.com". Okta admin is "it-admin@willowbank.com". CIDR coming tomorrow.
Diego (Eng): Re SCIM/SSO: need Okta metadata file and whether they want SCIM user provisioning. Estimate 4 workdays to validate and test on Dedicated. Create ENG-4301 for this.
Nia (Support): I'll draft runbook and observability checklist, add latency alerts for 95/99 and spike detection. Creating SUP-2145.
Priya (CS): Proc/KMS risk: BillingBot notes legal addendum required for customer-managed KMS. If procurement >2w, recommend temporary managed KMS to avoid blocking. Priya: will schedule kickoff Wed 9am PT.
Liam (Sales): I'll push procurement and include cost calc request. Can CS attach a token/unit example to show monthly impact?
Priya (CS): Yes 5 I'll request projection from Optimize and add to kickoff deck. Owners summary: Priya (CS) lead, Diego (Eng) ENG-4301, Nia (Support) SUP-2145, Liam (Sales) procurement. Kickoff invite to follow. :calendar:
